tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing gi bsdus don ljon shing mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba'i khog phub don 'grel rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ dge'o// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ mkhas grub bye ba'i shing rta'i srol chen po/ /nam yang 'khyog po'i lam du mi 'dren par/ /rgyal ba sras bcas gshegs pa'i shul nyid du/ /'dren mdzad 'khor lo'i mgon la phyag bgyi 'o/ 1 /dpal ldan grags pa'i zab yangs thugs mtsho las/ /snyan brgyud bzhi yi rtsa ba rab brtan zhing / /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i sdong po khyon yangs par/ /mkhas grub 'bum sde'i bzhed srol yal ga'i tshogs/ 2 /dri med lung gi lo 'dab rab rgyas shing / /yang dag rigs pa'i me tog 'phreng mdzes la/ /'dod dgu 'byung ba'i 'bras bu dang ldan pa/ /mngon par rtogs pa rin chen ljon shing 'khrungs/ 3 /gang de'i dgongs 'grel mdzad po mang mchis kyang / /yongs 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang po e wam̐ pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi/ /legs bshad ljon shing mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba'i/ 4 /bsdus don legs par bshad pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /rin chen 'phreng 'di blo gsal rnams la sbyin/ /dges par mdzod la legs bshad yi ger bris/ /rang gzhan mgrin pa mdzes pa'i rgyan byos shig /de la 'dir/ rgya bod kun na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan rje btsun rin po che dpal ldan grags pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing gi bsdus don ljon shing mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di nyid 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don dang gsum/ dang po la mchod par brjod pa/ bshad par dam bca' ba/ bstan bcos kyi sgra don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha ratna wardhā ya/ brtan g.yo kun khyab gzhol med rdo rje'i sku/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gang de'i drin las rtog ge'i yul min pa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ spel legs tshig gi me tog las 'ongs pa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ lus rnam par gzhag pa'i tshul gyis mngon rtogs kyi grangs bshad pa dang / yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'i tshul gyis dka' ba'i gnad rnams so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos pa bzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang nyer gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la rgyu'i rgyud sngon du 'gro ba rten gyi gang zag des nyams su blang bar bya ba thabs kyi rgyud/ de nyams su blangs pa las byung ba 'bras bu'i rgyud dang gsum/ dang po la rgyu la ltos pa/ rigs dang spang bya la ltos pa/ rkyen la ltos pa dang gsum/ dang po la sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi snying po can du bstan pa/ rgyu gang gis gang du 'khor ba/ rkyen gang gis ji srid du 'khor ba/ sems sbyangs na grol ba'i tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'gro sems rang bzhin spros bral chos sku'i dngos/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de lta na yang rang gi rang bzhin la/ /zhes sogs tshigs rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ ngar 'dzin dbang gis chags sogs nyon mongs dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ 'on kyang sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' ltar/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa rigs dang spang bya la ltos pa ni/ chos nyid dbye ba med kyang chos can gyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ rkyen 'gas cung zad 'gyang yang grol 'gyur zhes/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa des nyams su blang bar bya ba thabs kyi rgyud la/ skal dman rim gyis 'jug pa'i lam rim dang / skal ldan cig char du 'jug pa'i lam rim gnyis/ dang po la/ thun mong pa'i theg pa la rim gyis bslab pa dang /

thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa la rim gyis bslab pa gnyis/ dang po la spyod pa rim pa can la bslab pa dang / lta ba rim pa can la bslab pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshams sbyar ba dang / bslab tshul dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar rgyu la gnas kyang smin grol gyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la skyabs su 'gro ba/ dus tshigs kyi gso sbyong / so sor thar pa gtan khrims bdun/ dus nam skye nges pa med pa'i sems bskyed la bslab pa dang bzhi/ dang po la rgyu gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba/ yul gang la skyabs su 'gro ba/ tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba/ skyabs 'gro'i phan yon/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya/ skyabs 'gro'i sgra don/ skyabs 'gro'i dbye ba dang bdun/ dang po ni/ 'jigs dang dad pa'i sgo nas zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ skyabs kyi mchog dkon mchog gsum la zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ snying nas skyabs song ste/ zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ de yi phan yon yid la nges pa'i blos/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa ni/ spyi dang so so'i bslab bya kun la bslab/ /ces pas bstan/ drug pa ni/ tshul des 'jigs pa kun las skyob nus pa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bdun pa la rgyu 'bras kyi skyabs 'gro dang / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'di la ston lam grogs su 'dzin pa dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'bras skyabs rgyu dang dus dang dgos phyed bzhis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa dus tshigs kyi gso sbyong la/ ming don/ bslab bya/ cho ga dgos pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de ltar skyabs su song ba'i gang zag des/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ yan lag brgyad pa zhes pas bstan/ /gsum pa ni/ legs blangs nas/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ tshul bzhin bsrung la phan yon ches mang ldan/ /zhes pas bstan/

gsum pa so sor thar pa gtan khrims bdun la/ gang zag bsam pa/ rab dbye/ thob byed kyi cho ga gtong ba'i rgyu/ bsrung tshul dang drug dang po ni/ ji srid 'tsho bar tshul khrims bsrung nus pa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'tshe dang ngan song 'khor ba las thar phyin/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa la rab dbye dngos dang / de nyid bslab pa'i gnas bcur bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ skyes dang bu med so so'i bslab pa'i tshigs/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ rang gi gzhung bzhin len dang zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa ni/ gtong ba'i rgyu/ /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa ni/ bsrung tshul phyir bcos dang bcas nges par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa dus nam skye nges pa med pa'i sems bskyed ni/ de lta'i skabs su gzhan phan byang chub sems/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa lta ba rim pa can du bslab pa la/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / lam rim dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar bslab pas spyod pa dag gyur nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la bye brag tu smra ba/ mdo sde pa/ rnal 'byor spyod pa ba/ dbu ma pa'i lta ba la bslab tshul dang bzhi/ dang po la shes bya'i gnas/ zag bcas/ zag med bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ rgyas par dbye ba dang / bsdus te bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya'i gnas ni phung po skye mched khams/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la mdor bstan dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yang gzugs sems sems las byung ba dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la snang ba gzugs kyi gzhi/ gtso bo sems kyi gzhi/ 'khor sems byung gi gzhi/ ldan pa ma yin pa 'du byed kyi gzhi/ 'dus ma byas rtag pa'i gzhi dang lnga/ dang po ni/ gzugs kyi khams na gzugs rdzas nyung mtha' drug /ces sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/

gnyis pa ni/ sems ni rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ sems las byung ba sems kyi sa mang dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ mi ldan 'du byed thob dang ma thob dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ lnga pa ni/ nam mkha' gzugs can go 'byed rdzas su yod/ /ces sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa zag bcas la mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam bden ma gtogs 'dus byas zag bcas te/ /zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang / rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa snod dang bcud/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ de rgyu kun byung las dang nyon mongs gnyis/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la las kyi kun 'byung bden pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung bden pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ las kyi kun 'byung sems pa dang des byas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ nyon mongs kun 'byung rtsa nyon nye nyon no/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa zag med bshad pa la/ bden pa'i dbye ba bstan pa/ de'i mngon par rtogs pa skye tshul/ de ltar skyes pa'i gang zag gi dbye ba/ gang zag rnams kyi shes pa'i dbye ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par bstan pa dang lnga/ dang po la/ bden pa bzhir dbye ba dang / gnyis su dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lam gyi dmigs pa sdug kun 'gog lam bzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ mi rtag sdug bsngal stong dang bdag med pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa nges phyir 'phags pa'i bden par brjod/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa bden pa gnyis su dbye ba ni/ bcom dang cha shas bsal bas der 'dzin gyi/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa de'i mngon rtogs bskyed tshul la/ zhi gnas sgrub tshul dang / lhag mthong sgrub tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ bden pa'i mngon rtogs thog mar tshul khrims bsrung / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de nas lhag mthong bskyed rim lam lngar 'jug /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam dang lnga/ dang po ni/ tshogs kyi lam du dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ /zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ drod rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de lta'i chos dran goms pas bden pa la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ drod gsum rim bzhin bsgom pas bden pa la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ rtse mo rnam gsum 'phel las bden pa yis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ de nas rgyu gzhan med pa rang stobs kyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa mthong lam bden pa mngon rtogs skye ba'i rim pa dang / de'i mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos mchog mjug thogs de ma thag pa ru/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de lta'i bzod pa brgyad ni mthong spang gi /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ bzhi pa sgom lam ni/ de nas sgom pa'ang gnyen po sgom pa'i lam/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ lnga pa mi slob lam ni/ de nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa de ltar bskyed pa'i gang zag gi dbye ba la/ rigs can gsum gyi dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang / nyan thos kyi dbye ba bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dbye ba dngos dang / de gsum gyi 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam la 'jug pa'i gang zag rigs can gsum/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos myur na tshe gsum dag gis 'grub/ /ces sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa nyan thos kyi dbye ba bye brag tu bshad pa la/ nyan thos so skye'i dbye ba dang / nyan thos 'phags pa'i dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos so skye dad dang chos rjes 'brang / /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / dgra bcom gyi dbye ba bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag brgyad/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ yongs nyams 'chi bar sems dang rjes su bsrung / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ bzhi pa gang zag rnams kyi shes pa'i dbye ba la/ bcur dbye ba dang / de dag gang zag gang la ldan pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes pa kun rdzob chos rje gzhan sems shes/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ skye 'phags la ldan tshul spyir bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas la yon tan ldan tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ so skye gcig gnyis mthong sgom bdun nam brgyad/ /ces sogs tshig rkang phyed gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan ldan tshul dang / thun mong ba'i yon tan ldan tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas rnams/ stobs dang mi 'jigs dran nyer thugs rje che/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la 'phags pa dang thun mong ba'i yon tan ldan tshul dang / so skye dang thun mong ba'i yon tan ldan tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ thun mong nyon mongs med dang smon gnas shes/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ mngon shes lnga dang bsam gzugs tshad med bzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ lnga pa ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par bstan pa la/ ming don/ rdzas kyi dbye ba/ zag bcas zag med du 'grub pa'i tshul/ rigs can gsum grol ba'i tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/

de dag thob byed snyom 'jug ting nge 'dzin/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de dag zag med lam gyi ye shes dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ 'di dag drod nas brtsams te mi g.yo ba'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa mdo sde ba'i lta ba la bslab pa la/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / don dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar bye brag smra ba'i gzhung nges nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la bye brag tu smra ba sun dbyung ba dang / rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mdo bas bstan bcos tshad mar byed pa dgag shes bya'i gzhi lnga char rdzas su 'dod pa dgag zhar byung shes pas yul 'dzin tshul mi 'thad par bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de la snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos grub rjes su dpag pas grub min pas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ phyi rol yul gyi rnam pa ma shar bas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa la/ mdo'i rab tu dbye ba/ mdo'i don gtan la dbab pa/ mdo'i tshig bshad pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de nas rang lugs mdo bzhin 'chad pa la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la ji snyed pa gtan la dbab pa/ ji lta ba gtan la dbab pa/ de dag gi khyad par gyi chos bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rnam rig ming gzugs mi ldan 'du byed dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ ji ltar snang ba shes pa nyid yin yang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcus bstan/ gsum pa ni/ sems dang sems byung rang gsal skad cig ma/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang dgus bstan/ gsum pa mdo'i tshig bshad pa'i tshul ni/ de dag ston byed mdo sde 'chad tshul ni/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gsum pa rnal 'byor spyod pa ba'i lta ba la/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / don dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar mdo sde pa yi lugs shes nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa mdo sde pa dgag pa dang / rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa gnyis/ dang po la/ theg chen bka' ma yin par 'dod pa dgag pa/ phyi don yod par 'dod pa dgag pa/ nyan thos kyi 'dod pa gzhan dgag pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mdo sde pa rnams rang lugs theg chen du/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ dngos dang / nyes spong gi lan dgag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ drug gi gcig char sbyar sogs rigs pa yis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ mngon sum dang 'gal ba spang ba dang / lung dang 'gal ba spang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs mngon sum dag dang 'gal zhes na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'ga' las phyi don yod par bshad ce na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gsum pa nyan thos kyi 'dod pa gzhan dgag pa ni/ mi ldan 'du byed btags pa tsam du mtshungs/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid der 'jug dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la brgyad las/ dang po shes bya'i gnas kun gzhi la/ kun gzhi yod pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de'i mtshan nyid/ de 'jug cing ldog pa'i dus/ de dbang phyug sogs dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ shes bya'i gnas ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ gnas skabs gnyis su dbye ba dang / de'i rang bzhin bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la rnam par smin pa'i kun gzhi dang / sa bon thams cad pa'i kun gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ de la rnam smin kun gzhi zhes bya ba/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/

gnyis pa ni/ de la dgos pa'i kun nyon bag chags ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa de'i rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ de ni kun 'gro dang 'grogs btang snyom pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ /gsum pa de 'jug cing ldog pa'i dus la/ 'jug pa'i dus dang / ldog pa'i dus gnyis/ dang po ni/ des na reg dang yid byed sogs bsdus nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sa bon gyi cha ldog pa'i dus dang / rnam smin gyi cha ldog pa'i dus gnyis/ dang po ni/ sa bon cha ni nyan rang dgra bcom dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam smin kun gzhi nyan rang lhag med dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ bzhi pa de dbang phyug sogs dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ kun gzhi rten cing 'brel 'byung la rtogs na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa mtshan nyid la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mtshan nyid gzhan dbang kun btags yongs grub gsum/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid gsum gyi ngo bo/ ming don/ rab dbye dang gsum/ dang po la/ so sor bshad pa/ grub mtha'i 'dod tshul tha dad par bstan pa/ phyi rol pa'i don mi 'thad pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po la/ gzhan dbang / kun btags/ yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid gsum/ dang po ni/ gzhan gyi dbang ni kun gzhi las byung ba'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ /kun btags don la med kyang rnam rig tsam/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ /yongs grub gzhan dbang rnam rig tsam dang nyid/ /ces sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ dgos pa bsdu ba dang / 'dod tshul dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ gal te phyi don med na rnam rig tsam/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ rnam brdzun pa'i 'dod tshul dang / rnam bden pa'i 'dod tshul gnyis/

dang po ni/ rnam brdzun pa rnams sna tshogs snang ba 'di/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam bden pa rnams sems nyid der snang phyir/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa phyi rol gyi don mi 'thad pa'i tshul ni/ de rnams mdo sde'i lung dang dngos cig nyid/ /ces sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ming don la/ gzhan dbang gi ming don/ kun btags kyi ming don/ yongs grub kyi ming don dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bag chags sa bon las skyes skad cig las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de la ming dang rgyu mtshan la sogs pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ rnam rig de las don gyi rnam pa sogs/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa rab dbye la/ gzhan dbang gi rab dbye/ kun btags kyi rab dbye/ yongs grub kyi rab dbye dang gsum/ dang po ni/ ma dag dag pa'i gzhan dbang rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ kun btags ngo bo khyad par kun rtog gam/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ yongs rdzogs 'gyur med phyin ci ma log gnyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa der 'jug pa'i tshul la/ gang zag gang 'jug pa/ rgyu gang gis 'jug pa/ tshul ji ltar 'jug pa/ gnas skabs gang du 'jug pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de don rtogs phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ ma gzhum spang pa zhi lhag gsum gyi 'jug /ces pas bstan/ gsum pa la/ kun btags la 'jug tshul/ gzhan dbang la 'jug tshul/ yongs grub la 'jug tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ thos pa'i sgo nas ming don ngo bo dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam rig tsam du chos kun shes par byed/ /ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ rnam rig 'du shes ldog nas chos kyi dbyings/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa gnas skabs dang gang du 'jug pa ni/ byang sems 'jug pa'i gnas skabs lam lnga ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa de'i rgyu 'bras phar phyin drug bshad pa la/ grangs nges pa/ go rim nges pa/ so so'i mtshan nyid gsum/ dang po ni/ de yi rgyu 'bras pha rol phyin pa drug /ces sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyu 'bras dman mchog rags dang phra ba'i rim/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ chags dang gdung ba kun 'khrugs le lo med/ /ces sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ lnga pa de'i rab tu dbye ba la/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcus sa bcu bgrod pa'i tshul/ sa rnams thob pa'i tshul/ dus ji srid gcig gis bgrod pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de dbye rab dga' la sogs sa bcu la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'di dag mos spyod rtogs dang grub pas thob/ /ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ myur du grangs med gsum gyis de mthar phyin/ /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa bslab pa gsum gtan la dbab pa ni/ lam mthar phyin byed bslab gsum nyan thos las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bdun pa 'bras bu spang ba phun tshogs ni/ thos pas bag chags goms las nyon mongs kun/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ brgyad pa 'bras bu ye shes phun tshogs bshad pa la/ sku gsum du dbye ba/ yan lag lngar dbye ba/ ma 'dres pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gzhan bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mdor bsdu ba dang / rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba/ zhar byung 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus bstan pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de yi ye shes phun tshogs sku gsum ste/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ sprul pa'i sku dang gsum/ dang po ni/ spros kun bral ba rang gi dbyings brnyes pas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/

gnyis pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs sku chos sku la brten te/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de bzhin sprul pa'i sku yang chos sku la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ de lta'i sku gsum nyid kyi ngo bo 'am/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa zhar byung 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus bstan pa ni/ gang de tshogs gnyis yongs su mthar phyin nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa yan lag lngar dbye ba la/ gnas gyur pa/ dkar po'i chos kyi gzhi yin pa/ gnyis su med pa/ rtag pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ de tshe kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ phyin drug rdzogs pas dkar po'i chos kyi gzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ yod dang med dang 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ brtag tu de bzhin nyid las 'gyur med phyir/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ lnga pa ni/ shin tu rnam dag de bzhin nyid gang des/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ma 'dres pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gzhan bshad pa ni/ tshad med rnam thar zil gnon la sogs pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa dbu ma pa'i lta ba la bslab pa la/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / don dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar dngos smra'i them skas la brten nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa dang / rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rnam bden pa gzhan dbang don dam du yod par 'dod pa dgag rnam brdzun pa yongs grub don dam du yod par 'dod pa dgag skye 'gag gnas gyur sogs la brtags te thun mong du dgag pa gsum/ dang po ni/ de la snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan/

gnyis pa ni/ yongs grub spros bral gzhan dbang la yod na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ skad cig tsam du bden par yod ce na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bco lngas bstan/ gnyis pa rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa la/ bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa/ skabs su babs pa'i don bshad pa/ nges don gyi 'dod tshul gzhan bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ kun rdzob kyi 'dod tshul dang / don dam pa'i 'dod tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ 'jig rten grags sde spyod pa/ bye brag tu smra ba dang tshul mtshungs pa/ sgyu ma lta bu ba/ mdo sde spyod pa/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ rang lugs kun rdzob bden pa'i rnam gzhag la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan dag kun rdzob shes bya'i bzhi lngar 'byed/ /ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ 'ga' las dngos kun sgyu ma lta bur bstan/ /ces pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ kha cig yul dang yul can rnam bcas 'dod/ /ces pas bstan/ lnga pa ni/ phal cher phyi nang chos kun rmi lam ltar/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa don dam gyi 'dod tshul ni/ de sogs kun rdzob 'dod tshul mang na yang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa skabs su bab pa'i don bshad pa la/ kun rdzob kyi ngos 'dzin dang / don dam gyi ngos 'dzin gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdor na so skye'i blo nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ ngos 'dzin dngos/ gnas skabs la ltos te bden pa gcig tu bshad pa/ de nyid dngos po dang dngos med gang yang ma yin par bstan pa/ des na spros pa mtha' dag dang bral bar bstan pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de rnams rang gzhan don dam bden pa ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gzhan la ltos te mi bslu bas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de nyid dngos dang dngos min yang min te/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ myang 'das dbyings ni spros pa dang bral yang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa nges don gyi 'dod tshul gzhan bstan pa ni/ 'ga' zhig phyi rol don du zhen pa dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa thun mong min pa'i theg pa la rim gyis bslab pa la/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / lam rim dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar thun mong theg pa la bslabs nas/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i lam rim la bslab pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ smin byed dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ thun mong min pa'i dang po bya rgyud la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis dang bzhi chas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rigs sngags 'dul ba la bslab ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ smin byed dbang dang / grol byed lam gnyis/ dang po la/ spyod rgyud smin byed chu dang cod pan dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gtsang sbrar ldan pas rang nyid lhar bsgom ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud la/ rdo rje slob ma'i rigs can 'jug tshul dang / slob dpon gyi rigs can 'jug tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ smin byed dbang dang / grol byed lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang slob ma'i rigs can la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rig pa'i dbang tsam byin nas yi dam gyi/ /bzlas bsgom tsam la rim gyis bslab pa dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa slob dpon 'jug tshul la/ smin byed dbang dang / grol byed lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi rigs yin na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dam tshig dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/

bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi lam rim la/ bla med kyi lam rim spyir bstan pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i smin grol bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de nas rnal 'byor chen po bla med kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rdo rjes thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa skal ldan gcig char du 'jug pa'i lam rim la/ smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam gnyis/ dang po la/ sngon du 'gro ba'i dbye ba dang / dngos gzhi dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ skal ldan mchog gi rigs can skyabs 'gro dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sngon du bsnyen pa/ sa'i cho ga sta gon du gnas pa/ bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur ba/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'jug gi bya ba dang bdun/ dang po ni/ mtshan dus grangs kyi bsnyen pa ci rigs pas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ brtags bslangs sbyangs bzung bsrungs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ sa lha lha dang bum pa slob ma rnams/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ de rjes thig dang tshon gyis bri ba dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ lnga pa ni/ sgrub cing mchod nas zhes pas bstan/ drug pa la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag nyid 'jug sogs bya zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ 'jug pa dang / dbang bskur ba'i dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ de nas slob ma 'jug la phyi nang gnyis/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la dngos dang / dbang gi grangs gzhan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ thun mong dbang drug thun mong min pa bzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ yang na bum dbang bcu gcig gsang dbang lnga/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ bdun pa dkyil 'khor chen po'i mjug gi bya ba ni/ yon dbul dkyil 'khor mchod nas gshegs gsol dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa grol byed kyi lam la/ lam la bslab pa'i rim pa dang / de la slob pa'i gang zag gi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs/ thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs/ gnyis ka la dgos pa'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ de kho na nyid kyi lta ba/ lam rim pa gnyis/ spyod pa/ nye rgyu/ bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ lta ba thog mar bstan pa'i dgos pa dang / dgos pa de ldan gyi lta ba ston pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang de sngon du song nas chos kun gyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ dbang gi ye shes bstan pa de kho na nyid kyi don la ngo sprad pa/ ye shes de la gang zag gi bdag tu log par rtog pa dgag pa/ yul can ye shes la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i phyir yul shes bya spyi'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa dang / de kho na nyid de gsung rab thams cad kyi brjod byar bstan pa/ de rtogs byed khyad par du 'phags pa gsang sngags kyi thabs zab mos rtogs par bstan pa dang lnga/ dang po la/ ye shes de yul la ltos nas 'khor 'das dbyer med du bstan pa/ yul can la ltos nas dbyer med kyi ye shes de rang rig sogs su bstan pa/ des na chos thams cad kyi bdag nyid dam khyab byed du bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lta ba zhes bya kun khyab de bzhin nyid/ /ces sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ rang rig tu bstan pa/ spros bral du bstan pa/ zung 'jug tu bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de nyid so so rang rig ye shes te/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rig bya rig byed dang bral stong pa nyid/ /ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ dngos dang dngos med gnyis min zung du 'jug

/ces pas bstan/ gsum pa des na thams cad kyi bdag nyid dam khyab byed du bstan pa ni/ rang bzhin kun khyab mtshan nyid du mar snang / /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ye shes de la gang zag gi bdag tu log par rtog pa dgag pa la/ dgag bya log rtog gi dbye ba dang / de dgag pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ de la log par goms pa'i blo can dag /ces sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos kun rang bzhin legs rtogs ye shes de'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa yul can ye shes la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i phyir yul shes bya spyi'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa la/ bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / mtha' bral gyi lta ba rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan gzhi la mtshan nyid nges par bya ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / mtshan nyid dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ ye shes de la sgro bskur spang pa'i phyir/ de yul bden gnyis nges bya zhes tshig rkang phyed gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ go rim bzhin/ zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos can mtha' dag kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la yul can blo'i rnam gzhag dang / blo de la ltos nas bden pa gnyis su bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'on kyang bden gnyis blo la ltos pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ blo ngo gnyis la ltos nas bden pa gnyis su dbye ba/ gnyis po de'i gcig dang tha dad bsam pa/ bden pa gnyis su grangs nges pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ dbye gzhi/ dbye don/ rtsod pa spang ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bden gnyis ngo bo'i sgo nas dbyer med pas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ ma brtags ma dpyad blo ngor bden pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/

gsum pa la rtsod pa dang / lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ gal te don dam blo las 'das she na/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ rnam grangs pa'i don dam blo'i yul du bstan pa/ rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam blo'i yul ma yin par bstan pa/ de las rtsod pa spang ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ so skye'i blo yis legs brtags skye med sogs/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes spros bral du/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa la/ rtsod pa dang / lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ ci ste don dam blo yi yul min na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas rtog med brnyes pa'i tshe/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa gnyis po de'i gcig dang tha dad bsam pa ni/ de phyir bden gnyis ngo bo dbyer med la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa bden pa gnyis su grangs nges pa ni/ de ltar phyin ci log dang ma log blo/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa mtshan gzhi la mtshan nyid nges par bya ba ni/ gang la rigs pas brtags na de 'jig kyang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa mtha' bral gyi lta ba rgyas par bshad pa la/ thams cad yod par bshad pa de kun rdzob kyi bden par gtan la phab pa dngos smra ba dang tshul mtshungs shing khyad par du 'phags par bstan pa/ thams cad med par bshad pa de shes rab kyi blo yul du gtan la phab pas theg chen spyi dang tshul mtshungs shing khyad par du 'phags par bstan pa/ gnyis med kyi blos mtha' bral du gtan la phab pa nas zung 'jug tu nyams su blang bar bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ phung khams skye mched bshad pas nyan thos sde pa dang tshul mtshungs shing mu stegs byed las khyad par du 'phags par bstan pa dang / yul snang la rang bzhin med pa dang snang ba sems su bshad pas sems tsam pa dang tshul mtshungs shing nyan thos las khyad par du 'phags par bstan pa gnyis/

dang po ni/ de la rtag chad sgro bskur bsal ba dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ yul snang la rang bzhin med par bstan pa dang / snang ba sems su bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de lta'i yul du snang ba ji snyed pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sems kyi yon tan/ sems kyi mtshan nyid/ sems kyi nus mthu/ sems kyi rang bzhin bstan pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de ltar chos kun rang bzhin gyis dag na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de phyir gsal rig 'khor 'das kun gyi rgyu/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de nyid thabs kyi 'gyur bas dgos 'dod kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ de yi rang bzhin skye med nyid yin yang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa thams cad med par bshad pa de shes rab kyi yul du gtan la phab pas theg chen spyi dang tshul mtshungs shing khyad par du 'phags par bstan pa la yul ma grub pa'i phyir yul can gyi shes pa'ang mi 'grub pas sems tsam pa las khyad par du 'phags pa bstan pa dang / kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu yin yang don dam par gnas lugs 'di'o zhes mi 'dod pas dbu ma ngo bo nyid med pa las khyad par du 'phags par bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs rkyen la ltos phyir ngo bos med/ /ces sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ kun rdzob chos kun rgyu rkyen gyis bskyed cing / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa gnyis med kyi blos mtha' bral du gtan la phabs nas zung 'jug tu nyams su blang bar bstan pa la/ stong pa sogs bzhi ka'ang mtha' yin par bstan pa/ mtha' bral gyi dbu ma zhes bya bar 'dzin pa'ang mtha' yin par bstan pa/ de ltar mtha' dang bral yang zung 'jug gi tshul gyis nyams su blang bar bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ gnas lugs mi 'dod pa dang /

de la rtsod pa spang ba gnyis/ dang po la/ gnas lugs nges par 'dod na gnod byed yod pa/ nges pa blo'i yul du mi rung ba/ blo la ma ltos pa'i yul mi rung ba/ mthar bzung na srid pa'i rtsa bar 'gyur bar bstan pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ gcig dang du ma bral phyir yod ma yin/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gnas lugs nges par yod min pas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ gal te stong nyid ces bya blo nyid la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ de phyir 'dzin cing mngon par zhen pa kun/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa de la rtsod pa spang ba ni/ de ltar gnas lugs gang du'ang ma grub pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa mtha' bral gyi dbu ma zhes bya bar 'dzin pa'ang mtha' yin par bstan pa ni/ dgag bya med na bkag pa yod min pas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa de ltar mtha' dang bral yang zung 'jug gi tshul gyis nyams su blang bar bstan pa la/ zung 'jug gi rang bzhin/ don dam par bsam du med pa/ kun rdzob tu bsgom pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de ltar 'dzin pa kun bral lta ba la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de nyid dam pa'i don du bsam bya las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ 'on kyang kun rdzob tsam du rnam rtog gis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid de gsung rab thams cad kyi rtogs byar bstan pa ni/ de nyid rtogs na shin tu don che bar/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ lnga pa de rtogs byed khyad par du 'phags pa gsang sngags kyi thabs zab mos rtogs par bstan pa la/ de thabs gzhan gyis mi rtogs shing gsang sngags kyi thabs kyis rtogs par bstan pa/ gsang sngags kyi lta ba las khyad par du ye shes bstan pa/ de mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes su bstan pa/

de lus la gnad du bsnun pas rtogs pa'i phyir rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ tshul de pha rol phyin pa'i thos bsam la/ zhes pa nas/ /bsod nams tshogs las rnyed 'gyur zhes pa'i bar tshig rkang phyed lngas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ rang bzhin lhan skyes la sbyar te spyi don du bshad pa dang / zhu bde lhan skyes la sbyar te sbas don du bshad pa gnyis/ /dang po ni/ gang de yi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed drug gi bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ yang na ngo bo zhu bde'i ye shes che/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gsum pa de dpe'i ye shes su bstan pa ni/ gang de mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes te/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa de lus la gnad du bsnun pas rtogs pa'i phyir rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa la/ thog mar lus 'jig pa'i tshul/ zhig nas skye ba'i tshul/ skyes nas gnas pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de nyid lus la brten nas rtogs pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ 'chi srid las bar srid ldang ba'i tshul dang / bar srid las skye srid len pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ slar yang de las ldang 'dod dang 'grogs pa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ lus ngag yid gsum phan tshun rten dang brten pa'i tshul/ sems las lus ngag ji ltar skye ba'i tshul/ de dpe brgyad dang stong pa gsum gyi rten 'brel las skye ba'i tshul/ de skye gnas bzhis 'grub pa'i tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ skye tshe sems nyid g.yos pas rlung 'byung zhing / /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ dngos dang / sems gang las skyes tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ gal te 'byung ba bzhi las lus skye na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ dri ba dang / lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ ci ste sems nyid gang las skye zhe na/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/

sems ni 'od gsal zhes bya chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa de dpe brgyad dang stong pa gsum gyi rten 'brel las skye ba'i tshul la/ rten 'brel las skye ba dpes bstan pa/ de nyid stong pa gsum gyi rim pas skye ba'i tshul/ de yang rten 'brel bcu gnyis las skye ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de ltar snga ma'i shes pa phyi ma ru/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ mdor na snga ma'i kun gzhi 'od gsal la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcus bstan/ gsum pa ni/ /rmongs pas rgyu byas las kyi rkyen byas te/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ bzhi pa de skye gnas bzhis grub pa'i tshul la/ skye gnas bzhi spyir bstan pa dang / mngal skyes bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ skye gnas rdzus skyes sgo nga las skyes dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ lus gang las skye ba'i rgyu dang / rgyu des lus grub pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyu dngos dang / rgyu'i rnam grangs gzhan bshad pa mi 'gal bar bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de las phyi ma skabs 'dir bshad bya ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de la dngos dang dngos med sems gsum dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa rgyu des lus grub pa'i tshul la/ phra ba grub pa'i tshul dang / rags pa grub pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ de lta'i khu khrag rlung sems 'dres pa las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de tshe nya dang gnyis pa rus sbal mtshungs/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcus bstan/ gsum pa skyes nas gnas pa'i tshul la/ lus rtsa'i gnas tshul/ rtsa yi ge'i gnas tshul/ khams bdud rtsi'i gnas tshul/ snying po ye shes rlung gi gnas tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de ltar rtsa gsum de bzhin sum cu gnyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/

yi ge a dang de bzhin e wam̐ gnyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ byang chub sems ni dbu ma'i yas mar du/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ bzhi pa la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ byed las/ rgyu tshul/ lam du 'gyur tshul dang lnga/ dang po ni/ de la dbang byed rlung ni 'byung chen gyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba/ rgyu tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' shes pa'i rlung / /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ ye shes rlung ni gnas shing rnam rtog 'gog /ces sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ yan lag gi rlung lnga/ de bcu ka'ang 'byung ba lnga'i bdag nyid du bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mnyam gnas srog 'dzin gyen rgyu thur sel dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyu ba mig dang mnyam rgyu rna ba gnyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar bcu char 'byung lnga'i bdag nyid de/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa byed las la/ rlung spyi'i byed las dang / so so'i byed las gnyis/ dang po ni/ lus len rim gyis rgyas dang 'dzin pa dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i byed las dang / yan lag gi rlung lnga'i byed las gnyis/ dang po ni/ srog gi lus sems gnas dang sna sgor rgyu/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ yan lag rlung rnams mig sogs lam rgyus nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa rgyu tshul la/ spyir rgyu ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa/ tshul dang rnam pa ji ltar rgyu ba/ gnas dang lam gang nas rgyu ba/ grangs du zhig rgyu ba/ grangs de ltar 'ong ba'i 'thad pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ de ltar srog 'dzin ma gtogs gzhan dgu po/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ tshul ji ltar rgyu ba dang / rnam pa ji ltar rgyu ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ srog 'dzin dang po a ba dhu ti la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de rnams 'byung ba so so'i kha dog can/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gsum pa gnas dang lam gang nas rgyu ba ni/ srog 'dzin srog dang rtsol ba las byung ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ bzhi pa grangs du zhig rgyu ba ni/ de ltar sna sgo gnyis nas rgyu ba'i rlung / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ lnga pa grangs de ltar 'ong pa'i 'thad pa la/ 'thad pa dngos dang / rgyud sde so so'i dgongs pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar 'ong ba'ang snga mo'i bag chags ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ mkha' phreng gi dgongs pa dang / dges pa rdo rje'i dgongs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yang mkha' phreng dgongs pas zhag re la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcus bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dges rdor ltar na lte ba'i 'khor lo yi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bco lngas bstan/ lnga pa lam du 'gyur tshul ni/ de ltar shes nas man ngag ldan pa yis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa lam rim pa gnyis la/ rim gnyis spyi'i mngon rtogs dang / so so'i mngon rtogs gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / don dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar de nyid lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ ming don/ grangs nges pa/ grol ba'i rgyu mtshan/ go rim nges pa dang drug dang po ni/ nyams blang gtso bo sgrub pa po yi yid/ /ces sogs tshig rkang phyed gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ bskyed dang rdzogs pa gnyis/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ lus bskyed lhar bskyed mchog la brod pa bskyed/ /ces sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa la mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/

dang po ni/ spang bya tha mal rnam rtog lhar zhen spong / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ spang bya'i sgo nas gnyis su grangs nges pa dang / 'thob bya'i sgo nas gnyis su grangs nges pa/ rten dang brten pa'i sgo nas gnyis su grangs nges pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ spang bya tha mal rnam rtog sbyong ba'i tshul dang / gya nom lhar zhen sbyong ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa sbyong ba'i tshul dang / 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gi sbyong ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu ni las nyon te/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sbyang gzhi ngos bzung ba dang / de bskyed rim gyis ji ltar sbyong ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la dngos dang / rtsod pa spang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ spang bya nyon mongs rnam rtog las byung zhing / /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa/ rtsod pa dang lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ gal te rnam rtog kho na bskyed rim gyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs sogs snang ba sems nyid bag chags kyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa de bskyed rim gyis ji ltar sbyong ba'i tshul la/ snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong ba'i tshul dang / bcud kyi sems can sbyong ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ de lta'i tha mal snod du snang ba kun/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ bskyed chog gis skye gnas bzhi sbyong tshul dang / lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong tshul gnyis/ dang po la bskyed chog dngos la sbyar ba dang / sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bcud kyi skye gnas sbyong byed bskyed chog ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan yang ye shes tshogs kyis 'chi srid dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong tshul ni/ lha sku khro chags can bsgom zhe sdang dang /

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa gya nom lhar zhen sbyong ba'i tshul ni/ spang bya gnyis pa gya nom lhar zhen gyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa 'thob bya'i sgo nas gnyis su grangs nges pa la/ gzugs sku thob byed bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / chos sku thob byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'bras bu gzugs sku 'thob byed bskyed rim ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin chos sku thob byed rdzogs rim ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa rten dang brten pa'i sgo nas grangs nges pa la/ rtsod pa dang / lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ gal te rdzogs rim bsgom pas bskyed rim yang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rdzogs rim gyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed bzhis bstan/ lnga pa grol ba'i rgyu mtshan la/ rigs sam rgyu yin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa/ thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa/ dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ rgyu lam 'bras gsum phan tshun rigs dang rigs bdag tu 'gyur ba'i tshul/ lam gyi skabs su 'bras bu rigs bdag tu 'jog pa'i tshul/ des na rim pa gnyis kyis grol bar 'thad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'khor ba'i chos rnams de bzhin gshegs rigs te/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'on kyang lam gyi skabs su rgyu lam rigs/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ des na rim gnyis bsgom pas grol 'gyur te/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa la grol tshul dpe bstan pa/ grol byed kyi thabs dngos gnyis/ dang po la/ rigs 'dra gnyen por che ba/ bzlog pa gnyen por che ba/ sbam pa gnyen por che ba/ bsnan pa gnyen por che ba dang bzhi/

dang po ni/ brtan pa'i dug gis g.yo ba'i dug 'joms ltar/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rlung nad chung ngu mon sran gyis bzlog ltar/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ chu nyung mang po'i grogs kyis 'gugs pa ltar/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ tshig pa bsreg dpyad sogs kyis 'chos pa ltar/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa grol byed kyi thabs dngos ni/ mdor na rnam dag lta ba dang ldan pas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa la/ rgyu rgyud kyi dag pa/ thabs rgyud kyi dag pa/ 'bras rgyud kyi dag pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dngos rnams rang bzhin skye med de bzhin nyid/ /ces sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ spros bral lam byed lta ba de bzhin nyid/ /ces sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ bral 'bras ngo bo nyid sku de bzhin nyid/ /ces sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ drug pa go rim nges pa ni/ rim gnyis bskyed rim brtan nas rdzogs rim ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ gnyis pa so so'i mngon rtogs la/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gang zag gnas/ dus/ bsam pa/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang lnga/ dang po ni/ dbang thob dam tshig ldan zhing man ngag gi /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pos dben pa dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ mtshan mo'i dus sam thun gsum thun bzhi dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ mnyam rjes kun tu gzhan don bsam pa yis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gnyis kyis bstan/ lnga pa la/ bskyed bya lha'i rnam grangs dang / bskyed chog mngon rtogs kyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ mchog sgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang /

las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom bya de'i ngo bo/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ rgyud gsum/ so so bshad tshul dang / spyi'i rnam grangs gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsa rgyud las bshad tshul/ gur las bshad tshul/ sam pu ṭa las bshad tshul/ de dag la rtsod pa spang ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur las rigs kyang rgyas pa lnga/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ kha sbyor rgyud las dges pa rdo rje bzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gi bstan/ bzhi pa la/ rtsod pa dang / lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ gal te rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rdo rje 'chang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud gsung ba'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa spyi'i rnam grangs la/ man ngag lugs dang / 'grel pa lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar man ngag lugs kyi gsung sgros ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhung 'grel ltar na rtsa bshad gsum ka nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la/ ngo bo dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ las rgyas sgrub pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed lngas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ rtsa rgyud las bshad tshul/ gur las bshad tshul/ sam pu ṭa las bshad tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gur las 'byung po 'dul ba stobs po che/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ kha sbyor rgyud las sgrol ma rig byed ma/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa bskyed chog mngon rtogs kyi rnam gzhag la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/

rjes dang gsum/ dang po la/ rgyas pa dang / 'bring dang / bsdus pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgrub thabs sngon 'gro bsod nams tshogs bsag ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'bring du byed na khro bcu'i srung 'khor spang / /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ shin tu bsdu na tshad med bzhi tsam dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ mngon rtogs kyi chings dang lha'i bskyed chog gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyas pa dang / 'bring dang / bsdus pa gsum/ dang po la/ chings gsum so sor bshad pa dang / lha gang la mngon rtogs kyi chings gang sbyar ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi chings/ yan lag drug gi chings/ bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi'i chings dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gtso bo bskyed pa dang po sbyor ba dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhal med khang bskyed rnam par snang mdzad sku/ zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ lha bskyed bsnyen pa'i yan lag sku rdo rje/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa lha gang la mngon rtogs kyi chings gang sbyar ba'i tshul ni/ rigs bsdus rnams la chings gsum gang rung dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa 'bring ni/ 'di la mchod bstod spang pas 'bring du 'gyur/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ dbang bskur gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes gzhug /ces sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa lha'i bskyed chog ni/ bskyed chog mnyam sbyor dgu dang sam pu ṭa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa rjes ni/ rjes ni bzlas dang spyod lam kha zas dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ rdzogs rim gyi mtshan nyid/ rdzogs pa gnyis kyi spyi 'gro/ nyams su blang ba'i thabs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gang la gnad du bsnun pas lus sems la/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ lam la som nyi spang ba'i phyir phyi'i spros pa nang du bcad pa/ de nyid gtan la phab pas byang sems kyi ngo bo bstan pa/ de yis spang zhing bskyed par bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ sdom pa'i dbye ba'i sgo nas lus dang rtsa bstan pa dang / rtsa dang byang sems bstan pas sa lam nang du bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po la/ gnas gang du sdom pa/ grangs du zhig sdom pa/ spang bya gang sdom pa/ thabs gang gis sdom pa/ de ltar sdom pa'i ngo bo dang lnga/ dang po ni/ de yi rtsa ba nang gi sdom pa yi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ ji snyed chos kun ji snyed nang du sdom/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ mtshan rtog thams cad sdom zhing spong sems ldan/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ thabs ni phyag rgya'i lam dang gtum mo yis/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa ni/ bde bar gyur pa sdom pa'i ngo bo'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rtsa dang byang sems bstan pas sa lam nang du bsdu ba la/ bsgrub bya'i gzhi/ sgrub byed kyi lam/ bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum/ dang po ni/sa dang lam kun nang du bsdu ba'i gzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ thun mong ba la sbyar ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ thun mong la grags byang phyogs so bdun dang / /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ bskyed rim la sbyar ba dang / rdzogs rim la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po la/ rten la sbyar ba dang / brten pa la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bskyed rim ltar na gzhal yas khang gi cha/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ lha dang sbyar na gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa rdzogs rims la/ rten la sbyar ba dang / brten pa la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdzogs rim rten la sbyar tshe rtsa so bdun/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ brten pa de rnams las byung ye shes che/

/zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu ni/ mthar phyin 'bras bu sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa de nyid gtan la phab pas byang sems kyi ngo bo bstan pa la/ sbyong tshul spyir bstan pa dang / 'pho tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sbyang gzhi gang yin pa/ de sbyong byed kyi lha dang sbyar ba/ sbyangs pas thabs shes zung 'jug tu 'gyur ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dkar nag tshes dang bco lnga'i mtshan char bcas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ kun gyi snga ma bco lnga lha mo dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ sbyangs pas thabs shes zung du 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa 'pho tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la/ ji ltar 'pho ba'i tshul dang / de ltar 'pho ba'i 'thad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ pho mo'i dbye bas yar ngo mar ngo la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ phyi rol na ji ltar gnas pa lam la sbyar ba dang / des na chos thams cad sems su bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yang phyi rol rgyu skar nang gi rtsa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar snang ba thog med 'khor ba yi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa mi spang zhing bskyed par bstan pa ni/ de lta'i byang chub sems las yon tan kun/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa nyams su blang ba'i thabs la/ thabs gnyis nyams su blang ba'i tshul/ de las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ bskyed cing bogs dbyung ba/ mi mthun pa'i bar chad bsal ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi drod rtags dang lnga/ dang po la/ dmigs bcas dang / dmigs med bsgom pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ rang byin rlabs dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gnyis/ dang po la zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang / mi zab pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis/ dang po la/ so sor bsgom pa dang /

ldan par bsgom pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar sgro 'dogs bcad nas bsgom pa'i thabs/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud dang por gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa mi zab pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ gur las phra mo'i rnal 'byor cig bshad do/ /zhes pas bstan/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dmigs bcas la/ gang la bsten nas skye ba'i rten/ de ji ltar bsten pa'i thabs/ bsten pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi mtshan nyid dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dngos kyi phyag rgya dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya gnyis/ dang po la/ gnas skabs kyi sgo nas gsum du dbye ba dang / ngo bo la ltos te bzhir dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dmigs bcas skye ba'i rten/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sgra ji bzhin pa/ sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa/ dbang dang rjes su 'brel pa/ yon tan dang rjes su mthun pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ ma sring bu mo sring mo'i bu mo dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gdol ma zhes bya brgyad yin phan tshun sbyar/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de bzhin dbang gi sgo nas ma sogs brgyad/ /ces pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ ye shes sgo nas bcu drug dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni/ dgag bya'i dbang gis ye shes phyag rgya'ang bshad/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa de ji ltar bsten pa'i thabs ni/ bsten thabs 'du shes gsum ldan dbab bzung gnyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa bsten pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi mtshan nyid la/ gzhan lugs dgag pa dang / rang lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gnas la log par rtog pa/ ngo bo la log par rtog pa/ go rim la log par rtog pa dgag pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ byang sems gnas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gsum gyis bstan/

gnyis pa ni/ ye shes don du 'dod la gnod byed yod/ /ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ lhan skyes gsum par 'dod la lung 'gal dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa rang lugs bzhag pa la/ gnas yang dag pa/ ngo bo yang dag pa/ go rim yang dag pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de phyir gnas mchog mkha' gsang 'dzom pa'i rtser/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo mthong lam mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ go rim mtshan bral bzhi pa'i gnas skabs su/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa dmigs med bsgom pa'i tshul la/ gnyis ka'i dmigs pa la brten nas skyes pa'i ye shes bskyang tshul spyir bstan pa dang / rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs med bskyang tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de lta'i thabs gnyis gang yang rung ba las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dmigs med nam mkha' bsgom pa'i sbyor ba dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa de las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid la/ don dam spros bral kun rdzob lha sngags gnas pa'i tshul dang / 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rnal 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin las byung bar bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gal te chos kun ngo bos ma grub na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcus bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gal te de ltar bsgom kyang chos rnams kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gsum pa bskyed cing bogs dbyung ba la/ thabs kyi bstan tshul dang / de goms na rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar shes nas za 'chag la sogs kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de lta'i sbyor bas gnas na yul rkyen gyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa mi mthun pa'i bar chad bsal ba ni/ 'byung gdon ting nge 'dzin gyi bar chad gsum/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/

lnga pa ting nge 'dzin gyi drod rtags ni/ du ba la sogs rtags rnams myur du 'char/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa spyod pa la/ spyod pa'i sngon du 'gro ba drod dang / drod thob nas spyad pa'i spyod pa dngos gnyis/ dang po la/ drod kyi ngo bo/ dbye ba/ mtshan nyid/ ma thob pa thob par byed pa/ thob pa brtan par byed pa/ drod dang spyod pa mtshams sbyar ba dang drug dang po ni/ rim gnyis bsgom pa las byung zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ drod gsum ste/ gsum pa ni/ chos brgyad snyoms dang tshar bcad rjes bzung nus/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ de ma thob na brtson pas rim gnyis kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gsum gyis bstan/ lnga pa ni/ slar yang zla phyed du/ bsgom nas zhes pas bstan/ drug pa ni/ drod dang spyod pa rim bzhin sbyar/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa drod thob nas spyad pa'i spyod pa dngos la/ spyod pa'i ngo bo/ dbye ba/ mtshan nyid/ dus/ gang zag dgos pa dang drug dang po ni/ de la 'jug tshe yo byad kun btang nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de la gnyis/ zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ bzung 'dzin rnam rtog spong ba kun 'dar dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ gsang spyod sngon du song nas zla rer spyod/ /ces sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ lnga pa ni/ khyad chos gnyis ldan sgrub pos zhes pas bstan/ drug pa ni/ de spyad na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed kyis bstan/ bzhi pa nye rgyu bshad pa la/ nye rgyu'i dgos pa dang / nyams su blang pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos grub thob phyir gnas skabs gsum char ram/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyi bstan/ gnyis pa la/ ngo bo/ dus/ gnas/ rten/ thabs/ 'bras bu dang drug dang po la/ dngos dang / rtsod spang gnyis/ dang po ni/ ngo bo ā li kā li'i byang chub sems/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ /gal te sems la rtogs pa 'char ba ni/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa dus la/ bsgom pa'i dus dang / 'grub pa'i dus gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun bzang spyad nas sa lam lhag ma rnams/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gang de zhag bdun gyis 'grub drug pa yi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa gnas la/ phyi'i gnas dang / nang gi gnas gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yi gnas ni thun mong thun mong min/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ nang gi gnas ni e wam̐ 'jom pa'i rtse/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa rten ni/ phyag rgya ring nas goms dang grub pa thob/ /ces sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ lnga pa thabs ni/ de la thabs gnyis la rten/ /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa 'bras bu ni/ byang sems kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed bcu gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs la/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / don dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ gnas skabs rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma/ sbyin sreg rab gnas/ las tshogs rab 'byams dang lnga/ dang po la/ bzla bya'i sngags kyi ngo bo dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngags kyi ngo bo mtshan rtog kun las skyob/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ don dam pa'i sngags/ nang ltar bshad pa'i sngags/ phyi don gyi sngags dang gsum/ dang po ni/ don gyi sngags ni rang sems lhan cig skyes/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ nang ltar bshad pa'i sngags ni lte ba'i aṃ/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ phyi ma dag par bya phyir btu ba dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa gtor ma la/ spyir bstan pa dang / cho ga bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gtor ma dus dang yo byad cho ga dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ cho ga rdzas dang mgron dang 'bul sogs dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/

gsum pa sbyin sreg la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes/ de dag la dgos pa'i grangs dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sbyin sreg thabs dang bud shing sbar ba me/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma gtang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ mjug gi chos te drug gsum bco brgyad do/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa rab gnas la/ spyir bstan pa cho ga bye brag tu bshad pa/ cho ga'i grangs bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rab gnas rten dang slob dpon dus dang gnas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ cho ga sta gon dngos gzhi mjug gsum ste/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ re re'ang bdun bdun nyi shu rtsa gcig go /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa las tshogs rab 'byams la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ las tshogs rab 'byams dman 'bring 'bring gi mchog /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs dang / des sgrub pa'i dngos grub gnyis/ dang po la/ zhi sogs dman pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'bring grub chen brgyad sgrub thabs/ rab mkha' spyod sogs kyi sgrub thabs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dman pa rdzas sbyor 'khrul 'khor bzlas pa dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'bring ni bzlas bsgom rdzas sbyor la sogs pas/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ 'bring gi rab rnams bzlas bsgom tsam gyis so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa de bsgrubs pa'i dngos grub la/ zhi sogs dman pa'i dngos grub/ 'bring grub chen brgyad kyi dngos grub/ rab mkha' spyod sogs kyi dngos grub dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de las zhi rgyas dbang drag yan lag bcas/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ mig sman rkang byug ral gri sa 'og sgrub/ /ces sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/

gsum pa ni/ mkha' spyod rig 'dzin 'khor lo bsgyur rnams 'grub/ /ces pas bstan/ gsum pa gnyis ka la dgos pa'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa bshad pa la/ dam tshig gi rnam grangs bstan pa dang / de ji ltar bsrung ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i grogs ni dam tshig ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhi'i bstan/ gnyis pa la/ las dang po pas bsrung tshul/ drod chung 'bring thob pas bsrung tshul/ drod chen po thob pas bsrung tshul dang gsum/ dang po la/ mi nyams par bsrung ba'i tshul dang / nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs gnyis/ dang po la/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / bza' ba'i dam tshig gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyas par bsrung tshul dang / bsdus te bsrung tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ dang po'i las pas rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ bsrung tshul bsdu na sgo gsum dam tshig nyid/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa bza' ba'i dam tshig la/ rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig dang / khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig gnyis/ dang po la/ dngos dang / dgos pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bza' ba'i dam tshig rgyun du bsten bya ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de nyid shes pas bsten na mkha' 'gro mnyes/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig la/ ming gi don dang / de ji ltar bya ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyad par can gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la gang du bya ba'i gnas/ nam gyi tshe bya ba'i dus/ ji lta bus bya ba'i yo byad/ gang gis byed pa'i gang zag ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa dang drug dang po ni/ gang des dur khrod la sogs ches dben par/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyun dang khyad par can gyi dus kyi tshe/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ mchod pa'i yo byad thabs shes rdzas sogs bcas/

/zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ gang zag dam tshig rnam dag rnam rtog chung / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ lnga pa la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gnas khang rgyan te tshogs dang gtor ma bsham/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pas tshim/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ byin gyis rlob phyir rdo rje'i glu len dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ drug pa dgos pa ni/ de ltar drug gsum bco brgyad tshogs 'khor gyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs ni/ dam tshig nyams na bcas rang phra mo la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa drod chung 'bring thob pas bsrung tshul ni/ brtan pa thob pas gnyis spang spyod pa dang / /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa drod chen po thob pas bsrung tshul ni/ brtan pa cher thob 'khor 'das gnyis med du/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa de la slob pa'i gang zag gi dbye ba la/ dbang gi sgo nas dbye ba/ lam gyi sgo na dbye ba/ 'bras bu 'grub nye ring gi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de lta'i lam la slob pa'i gang zag ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ phyi la gzhol ba mngon rtogs bcu gcig po/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ yang rab tshe 'dir 'grub la bcud len dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gsum pa de nyams su blangs pa las byung ba 'bras bu'i rgyud la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / sa'i mngon rtogs zhib tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar mos spyod gnas skabs mthar phyin nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gnyis kyi bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sa rnams kyi rgyu/ rtogs pa'i khyad par/ grub pa'i rtags/

ming gi don dang bzhi/ dang po la/ brgyud pa'i rgyu dang / dngos kyi rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sa 'og ma rnams kyi dngos rgyu dang / sa bcu gsum pa'i dngos rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ de rnams dngos rgyu yul chen so gnyis kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de rnams kun gyi stobs sdom dbu ma la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ rab dga'i sa la chos dbyings kun 'gro'i tshul/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gsum pa grub pa'i rtags la/ sa dang po'i grub rtags dang / sa lhag ma rnams des bsgre ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rab dga'i rtogs pa skyes las grub pa'i rtags/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gnyis pa nas brtsams bcu gnyis bar dag la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyi bstan/ bzhi pa ming don la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i ming gis mdor bstan pa dang / de nyid thun mong ba'i ming la sbyar te rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ phyi'i yul gyi dbye ba dang / de nyid nang la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ de lta'i sa la gnas sogs brda' mdzad pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin nang na'ang so gnyis yul tshang zhing / /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa thun mong ba'i ming la sbyar te rgyas par bshad pa la/ sa so so'i ming don dang / spyi'i ming don gnyis/ dang po ni/ gnas sogs de dag rab dga' dri ma med/ /ces sogs tshig rkang phyed lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de rnams yon tan gyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu la/ 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i nye rgyu'i ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang / des mngon du byas pa'i 'bras bu dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ nye rgyu la brten 'bras bu'i ngo mtshar ltas/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ spyi dang mthun pa'i sku'i rnam gzhag dang / 'di nyid du grags pa'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid gnyis/ dang po la/ theg pa thun mong ba la grags pa dang / rdo rje theg pa la grags pa'i sku'i rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ sku gnyis su 'dod pa/ gsum du 'dod pa/ bzhir 'dod pa/ gsum du 'dod pa gzhan bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de yi ngo bo rnam grol chos sku dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las ngo bo nyid sku rten/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa la dngos dang / 'thad ldan gyi 'dod tshul gzhan bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi rjes 'brang 'brel byed 'ga'/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang dgus bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'ga' zhig chos sku mtshon par byed pa'i chos/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ bzhi pa sku gsum du 'dod pa gzhan bshad pa ni/ 'jug par skye 'gag la sogs kun zhi ba'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa la grags pa'i sku'i rnam gzhag la/ yan lag bdun ldan du 'dod pa/ sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan du 'dod pa dang / sku gnyis yan lag bcu bzhi par 'dod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sngags las longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de yi rang bzhin med pa chos sku dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa la sku'i dbye ba dang / yan lag gi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos bcas pa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sku dang po'i yan lag bdun dang / phyi ma'i yan lag bdun gnyis/ dang po ni/ spros pa kun bral chos kyi longs spyod gzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ zhal phyag rang bzhin med dang 'og min bzhugs/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/

gnyis pa 'di nyid du grags pa'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid la/ bshad bya'i sku/ 'chad byed kyi yan lag sku dang yan lag bsre ba gsum/ dang po ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ gnas yongs gyur dang ye shes sku/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das nyid dang / /gnyis su med pa nyid dang ni/ /mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'dus/ /zhes pa ltar lnga las dang po gnas yongs su gyur pa la/ phung po lnga gnas gyur pa/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi gnas gyur pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gnas gyur pa/ brten pa yid gnas gyur pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs phung po gnas gyur rigs lnga dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi sku bzhi zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ lus ngag yid/ /ces sogs tshig rkang phyed gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ kun gzhi'i chos nyid chos dbyings ye shes 'gyur/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi sku la/ sku med pa ma yin pa/ sku bem po ma yin pa/ ye shes lnga'i sku'i mtshan nyid/ sku gsum gyis ye shes lnga bsdus pa'i tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ lus gnas gyur pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ lam gyi skabs su lus ngag las kun gyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa la/ ye shes lnga so sor bshad pa/ de rgyu gang las byung tshul/ des sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad bsdus pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ me long ye shes gzhan gyi rten yin te/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ ye shes gang la chos kun gzugs brnyan gyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcus bstan/ gnyis pa de rgyu gang las byung ba ni/ thos 'dzin mnyam nyid bsgom dang chos rab ston/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/

gsum pa des sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad bsdus pa'i tshul ni/ chos kyi dbyings dang ye shes rnam bzhi yis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa sku gsum gyis ye shes lnga bsdus pa'i tshul la/ dngos dang / rtsod pa spang ba gnyis/ dang po la/ thun mong ba la grags pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa la grags pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ me long mnyam nyid sor rtog longs spyod rdzogs/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lnga bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ sngags gzhung dgongs pa me long chos kyi sku/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa rtsod pa spang ba la/ rtsod pa dang / lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ gal te sems ni spros pa dang bral la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ sems nyid las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang phyed bzhis bstan/ gsum pa mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la/ 'khor ba ma yin pa/ myang 'das ma yin pa/ des na zung 'jug tu bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ chags pa zhes bya skye ba 'khor ba dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gal te gzhan don 'byung dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar snying rjes 'jig pa myang 'das dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa gnyis su med pa ni/ de ltar srid zhi mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ lnga pa mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa ni/ de ltar snying rjes 'khor ba mi gtong phyir/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ gsum pa sku dang yan lag bsre ba ni/ de ltar rang bzhin rnam dag rgyu yi chos/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang nyer lngas bstan/ gsum pa mjug gi don la/ bka' drin dran pas phyag 'tshal ba/ bstan bcos kyi tshig don la bsngags pa/ legs cha bla ma la dbul ba/ nyes pa bzod par gsol ba/ dge rtsa bstan pa'i ched du bsngo ba/ rtsom pa po'i mtshan smos pa dang drug dang po ni/ swa sti pra dzwa bhyaḥ

dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi nye lam mchog /ces sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ brjod bya rgya che ba la bsngags pa dang / rjod byed 'dus che ba la bsngags pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ e ma rgyu rgyud nam mkha'i ngos yangs por/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gang 'di sde snod kun gyi lde mig ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa legs cha bla ma la dbul ba ni/ mang thos rnam dpyod lag pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa nyes pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ bdag gis 'dir 'bad 'di la nyes pa'i cha/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ lnga pa dge rtsa bstan pa'i ched du bsngo ba la/ spyi dang / khyad par gyi ched du bsngo ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ legs par bshad pa'i dge dang dge gzhan bcas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ /tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ drug pa mdzad byang smos pa ni/ ces rje btsun rin po che sogs nas grub pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan to/ /de dag gis ni spyir gzhung don 'chad pa'i tshul la/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ mtshams sbyar/ brgal lan dang lnga yod pa'i nang nas/ bsdus don gyi sgo nas gzhung 'chad tshul bstan pa yin la/ de la yang gzhung spyi'i bsdus don dang / gzhung so so'i bsdus don gnyis las 'dir bshad pa ni phyi ma yin te/ gzhung gi dbu zhabs ma lus pa'i don bsdus pa'i sgo nas khog phub pa ni gzhung so so'i bsdus don dang / gzhung spyi'i lugs rnam par gzhag pa tsam ni gzhung spyi'i bsdus don yin pas so/ /de skad du chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo las/ bsdus pa'i don la rnam gnyis te/ /ngag don bsdus te bstan pa dang / /gzhung don so so'i bsdus don no/ /don 'dus tshig gsal brjod pa bde/ /ngag nyung tshig snyom gzung ba sla/

/bsdus don nyid kyis gzhung go ba/ /de 'dra gang gis shes de mkhas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'dir smras pa/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang sa skya'i rje btsun mchog /dpal ldan grags pa'i zhabs kyi gsung rab gang / /rin chen ljon shing bsdus don legs bshad 'di/ /skal bzang mgul mdzes rin chen rgyan 'phreng yin/ 1 /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde rin chen bzhi'i/ /dgongs don gcig tu bsdus pa'i glegs bam la/ /slob par 'dod rnams khog phub don 'grel 'di/ /legs par ltos dang shes nas dad thob 'gyur/ 2 /de yang thog mar bsdus don gzhung la sbyongs/ /de nas khog phub don 'grel 'di bslab ste/ /phyis nas rin chen ljon shing legs bsten na/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i don kun shes par 'gyur/ 3 /kye ma deng dus sngags 'chang phal cher rnams/ /rgya chen gsung rab thos bsam lta zhog gi /sgrub dkyil sna re tsam gyi bsgom don yang / /bor nas tshig rkyang kho na gtso bor byed/ 4 /skal ngan ne tso'i 'don pa lhur len pa'i/ /skye bo de ni sngags 'chang gzugs brnyan yin/ /sngon gyi sa skya'i rjes 'jug sngags 'chang rnams/ /bshad pa rgyud sde kun la rab mkhas shing / 5 /nyams len man ngag rgya mtshor dbang 'byor te/ /lag len phra mo tshun yang ma 'khrul ba'i/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung zhes grags/ 6 /bdag kyang de 'dra'i rjes su slob 'dod nas/ /gong ma'i gsung rab phal cher phyogs tsam mthong / /rang gzhan 'jug pa bde phyir tshul 'di sogs/ /gsal byed yi ge'i tshogs kyang mang du bgyis/ 7 /de phyir kho bo'i rjes 'jug dpyod ldan 'ga'/ /yod na tshur spyon nyung gsal rtogs sla ba'i/ /bsdus don don 'grel 'di dang grogs gyis la/ /gong ma'i gsung rab kun la legs par sbyongs/ 8 /sa skya'i rje btsun rnams la dad pa'i blos/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len shes 'dod na/

/rin chen ljon shing 'di la legs slob dang / /drang nges kun la 'khrul med gdeng thob 'gyur/ 9 /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /don gnyis mthar phyin bstan pa rab rgyas nas/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog 10 /rje btsun gsung rab dgongs 'grel bshad pa las/ /las dkar bsags pa gang des 'gro ba kun/ /kun mkhyen grags pa'i gsung gi rjes 'gro zhing / /zhing 'dir phan dang bde ba'i rgyur gyur cig 11 /ces rje btsun rin po che dpal ldan grags pa'i zhabs kyi gsung rab yongs rdzogs bstan pa rin po che'i glegs bam mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing zhes bya ba'i bsdus don ljon shing rgyas par byed pa'i rgyan gyi khob phub don 'grel rin po che'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo padma'i rnam sprul bsod nams dbang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam par sprul pa byang chub sems dpa' sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros dang / rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang / sngon gyi skyes bu chen po tshul khrims 'bar gyi rnam par sprul pa/ lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don 'grub rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos spyir rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab mtha' dag dang / lhag par mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la yun ring mo nas 'dris par byas shing / tshig don la zhib tu dpyad pa dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan nyid la rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bshad pa gnang ba'i zin bris thor bu ba rnams la gzhi byas te rang gi slob ma rnam dpyod dang ldan zhing /
